Room comparison study

You will see pairs of interior photographs and choose, for each pair, which room looks more cluttered. It takes about 8–12 minutes. Participation is voluntary; you may stop at any time by closing the tab. Responses (your choices and how quickly you make them) are recorded for research on how people and an automated model judge spaces. No personal data beyond the identifier you enter is collected.

How it works

The question, every time: Which room looks more cluttered?

Cluttered = lots of competing visual elements, hard to take in at a glance. Judge only how cluttered it looks — not whether it is tidy, nice, or well-lit. Go with your first impression.

Controls

Press ← if the left room is more cluttered, → if the right room is more cluttered, or the space bar if you truly can't tell. You can also click the buttons. There are pairs.

Which room looks more cluttered?
